params.body: `composer.json` said `"php": "^8.2"` while CI, the Composer platform config and production all run PHP 8.5, and nothing below 8.5 has ever been tested. The README repeated that promise ("PHP 8.2 or newer"). Now the requirement says what is true: `^8.5`, so a `composer install` on an older PHP refuses instead of installing something unverified. `composer.lock` only gets its content hash updated; no package changes. The README stack line follows.
params.title: Require PHP 8.5 in composer.json, and say so in the README
